@transforms.add
def create_merge_info(config, tasks):
    for task in tasks:
        if "merge_config" not in config.params:
            break

        worker = task["worker"]

        action_name = list(worker["actions"][0].keys())[0]
        merge_config = task["worker"]["actions"][0][action_name]

        worker["merge-info"] = merge_config

        yield task
